title: Deeper/broader ACadRust-derived ACIS authoring fork and cross-route evidence ceiling
mode: Read-only review of primary project documentation, source tests, peer issue/PR state, and local plan reconciliation
scope: Screen a newly surfaced open-source ACIS SAT/SAB authoring candidate.
Separate derivative authoring claims from independent parser, kernel, semantic, and native-consumer evidence.
Refresh the existing PAR-07/S8 gates for source-to-output payload disposition and entity-family-specific consumers without adding routine validation work.

sources.observed: The README describes an ACadRust-derived fork for the Hekatan viewer and advertises SAT text writing for R2000-R2007, SAB binary writing for R2013+, selected analytic primitives, and 208/208 round-trip integrity. The reviewed GitHub repository page exposed no release. Source/test subpages were unavailable to this pass, and the project was not acquired or executed.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Discovery-only, lineage-correlated authoring claim. No immutable artifact, test behavior, independent parser/kernel result, or semantic/native acceptance was established.

sources.observed: The current README advertises SAT/SAB and B-rep facilities. The visible roundtrip source contains a synthetic marker SAB helper and a generated planar cube DWG roundtrip whose inspected assertions check entity/payload presence and has_ds_data, not independent topology, B-rep validity, analytic metrics, or native CAD acceptance.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Same-codec/transport evidence for the inspected assertions; not independent solid semantics or validation of the derivative fork.

sources.observed: Issue #1195 reports silent 3DSOLID/REGION omission by the DXF writer in version 3.4.9, including solids inside blocks. PR #1240 remained a proposal in the reviewed PR listing; this pass did not establish the behavior of a released artifact.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Version-specific peer failure report and unmerged proposal, not a libdxfrw defect or current released-peer result.

sources.observed: FreeCAD documents distinct C++ and legacy importer entity sets, names 3DFACE only in its legacy list, does not name MESH in either published list, and says stock FreeCAD cannot read embedded ACIS/SAT solids. ezdxf says ACIS data creation requires an external library and documents limited ACIS parsing/projection rather than general B-rep semantics.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Documentation-defined consumer/authoring boundary; no runtime qualification was performed.

assessment.planEffect: Registers the newly surfaced ACadRust-derived authoring fork as DISCOVERY_ONLY / ACADRUST_LINEAGE / ARTIFACT_AND_TESTS_UNBOUND; prohibits promotion from README claims or same-codec readback; preserves the existing per-handle/block/INSERT carrier ledger, independent analytic semantic gate, FreeCAD entity-family/backend boundary, and fast implementation cadence.

limitations: GitHub source/test subpages for the derivative fork were unavailable to this review; its README claims were not independently verified.
No peer artifact, repository, application, external drawing, or kernel was executed.
The upstream ACadRust test source is mutable main; its assertions were reviewed as test-design evidence, not as a pinned release qualification.
